```{r}
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

path = "csv_export/"

omega    = read_csv(paste0(path, "OMEGA.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
drg      = read_csv(paste0(path, "DRG.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
crit     = read_csv(paste0(path, "CRIT.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ome_dx   = read_csv(paste0(path, "OME_DX.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ome_px   = read_csv(paste0(path, "OME_PX.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
dx11     = read_csv(paste0(path, "9DX11.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
op11     = read_csv(paste0(path, "9OP11.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
dispostn = read_csv(paste0(path, "DISPOSTN.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
service  = read_csv(paste0(path, "SERVICE.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
source   = read_csv(paste0(path, "SOURCE.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
mdclist  = read_excel("data.xlsx")

# clean OMEGA
omega_clean = omega %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    DISTANCE   = ifelse(DISTANCE > 65534, NA, DISTANCE),
    TOT_CHARGE = ifelse(TOT_CHARGE < 0, NA, TOT_CHARGE),
    TOT_PAY    = ifelse(TOT_PAY < 0, NA, TOT_PAY),
    TOT_COST   = ifelse(TOT_COST < 0, NA, TOT_COST),
    RACE       = ifelse(RACE == "UNKNOWN", NA, RACE)
  )

# MDC lookup — distinct only
mdc_lookup = mdclist %>%
  select(mdc_code, service_line) %>%
  distinct()

# join DRG to MDC
drg_mdc = drg %>%
  left_join(mdc_lookup, by = c("MAJ_DX_CAT" = "mdc_code"))

# join OMEGA to DRG+MDC, add profit and LOS outlier
omega_main = omega_clean %>%
  left_join(drg_mdc, by = "DRG") %>%
  mutate(
    profit      = TOT_PAY - TOT_COST,
    los_outlier = ifelse(LOS > CUTOFF, 1, 0)
  )

# aggregate CRIT
crit_agg = crit %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(PAT_NO, ADM_DATE) %>%
  summarise(
    total_icu_days = sum(ICU_LOS, na.rm = TRUE),
    icu_stays      = n(),
    .groups        = "drop"
  )

# aggregate OME_DX
ome_dx_agg = ome_dx %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(PAT_NO, ADM_DATE) %>%
  summarise(
    total_diagnoses = max(TOT_NO_DXS, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_dx_codes = n_distinct(DIAGNOSIS),
    .groups         = "drop"
  )

# aggregate OME_PX
ome_px_agg = ome_px %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(PAT_NO, ADM_DATE) %>%
  summarise(
    total_ops       = max(TOT_NO_OPS, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_op_codes = n_distinct(OP_PROC_9),
    .groups         = "drop"
  )

# newborn linkage
mother_records = omega_clean %>%
  select(PAT_NO, ADM_DATE, TOT_CHARGE, TOT_COST, TOT_PAY) %>%
  rename(mother_pat_no   = PAT_NO,
         mother_adm_date = ADM_DATE,
         mother_charge   = TOT_CHARGE,
         mother_cost     = TOT_COST,
         mother_pay      = TOT_PAY)

newborn_mother = omega_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(MOTHER_MRN) & MOTHER_MRN != 0) %>%
  select(PAT_NO, ADM_DATE, MOTHER_MRN, TOT_CHARGE, TOT_COST, TOT_PAY) %>%
  left_join(mother_records,
            by           = c("MOTHER_MRN" = "mother_pat_no", "ADM_DATE" = "mother_adm_date"),
            relationship = "many-to-many")

# final dataset
df_full = omega_main %>%
  left_join(crit_agg,   by = c("PAT_NO", "ADM_DATE")) %>%
  left_join(ome_dx_agg, by = c("PAT_NO", "ADM_DATE")) %>%
  left_join(ome_px_agg, by = c("PAT_NO", "ADM_DATE")) %>%
  left_join(dispostn %>% rename(dispostn_desc   = DESCRIPT), by = "DISPOSTN") %>%
  left_join(source   %>% rename(adm_source_desc = DESCRIPT), by = "ADM_SOURCE") %>%
  left_join(service  %>% rename(adm_svc_desc    = DESCRIPT), by = c("ADM_SVC" = "SERVICE"))

cat("Final rows:", nrow(df_full), "\n")
cat("Final cols:", ncol(df_full), "\n")
```


```{r}
selected_lines = c("Orthopedic", "Perinatology", "HIV", "Cardiology")
df_selected = df_full %>%
  filter(service_line %in% selected_lines) %>%
  select(
    PAT_NO, ADM_DATE, DIS_DATE,
    AGE, AGE_DAYS, BIRTH_WGHT, SEX, RACE, DISTANCE, ZIP,
    ADM_TYPE, ADM_SOURCE, DISPOSTN, dispostn_desc,
    CCSTAY, LOS, CUTOFF, ARITH_LOS, ELOS_UNTR, LOS_B_SURG,
    TOT_CHARGE, TOT_PAY, TOT_COST, TOT_DIRECT,
    EXT_REV, MAJOR_PAY, TEACH_SVC, PRIM_PAY,
    DRG, MAJ_DX_CAT, ARITH_LOS, PARTITION,
    WEIGHT.y, service_line, PRINCPL_DX, PCONSULTS,
    profit, los_outlier,
    total_icu_days, icu_stays,
    total_diagnoses, unique_dx_codes,
    total_ops, unique_op_codes,
    adm_source_desc, adm_svc_desc,
    MOTHER_MRN
  ) %>%
  rename(drg_weight = WEIGHT.y, mdc_code = MAJ_DX_CAT) %>%
  mutate(
    LOS        = ifelse(LOS > CUTOFF * 3, NA, LOS),
    LOS_B_SURG = ifelse(LOS_B_SURG == 9999, NA, LOS_B_SURG),
    LOS_B_SURG = ifelse(LOS_B_SURG == 9998, NA, LOS_B_SURG),
  )
cat("Rows per service line:\n")
print(table(df_selected$service_line))
cat("Total rows:", nrow(df_selected), "\n")
cat("Total cols:", ncol(df_selected), "\n")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

service_colors = c("Cardiology"   = "#D7191C",
                   "Orthopedic"   = "#F4A11B",
                   "Perinatology" = "#2C7BB6",
                   "HIV"          = "#1A9641")

# 1. Negative and zero financial values
financial_issues = tibble(
  field    = c("TOT_CHARGE", "TOT_COST", "TOT_PAY", "TOT_DIRECT", "TOT_CHARGE = 0"),
  count    = c(24, 26, 4, 25, 1282),
  category = c("Negative", "Negative", "Negative", "Negative", "Zero")
)

p1 = ggplot(financial_issues, aes(x = reorder(field, count), y = count, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = comma(count)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Negative" = "#D7191C", "Zero" = "#F4A11B")) +
  labs(title = "Invalid Financial Values in OMEGA",
       x = NULL, y = "Record Count", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  expand_limits(y = 1500)

print(p1)

# 2. DISTANCE invalid values
distance_issues = tibble(
  category = c("Valid", "Invalid (65,535)"),
  count    = c(nrow(omega) - 651, 651)
)

p2 = ggplot(distance_issues, aes(x = reorder(category, count), y = count, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = comma(count)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Valid" = "#2C7BB6", "Invalid (65,535)" = "#D7191C")) +
  labs(title = "DISTANCE Field: Valid vs Invalid Values",
       x = NULL, y = "Record Count", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  expand_limits(y = 18000)

print(p2)

# 3. Duplicate records by table
duplicates = tibble(
  table = c("OMEGA", "OME_DX", "OME_PX"),
  count = c(11, 72, 21)
)

p3 = ggplot(duplicates, aes(x = reorder(table, count), y = count, fill = table)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("OMEGA" = "#2C7BB6", "OME_DX" = "#D7191C", "OME_PX" = "#F4A11B")) +
  labs(title = "Duplicate Records by Table",
       x = NULL, y = "Duplicate Count", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  expand_limits(y = 85)

print(p3)

# 4. Missing RACE
race_missing = tibble(
  category = c("Known", "Unknown / Missing"),
  count    = c(nrow(omega) - 2970, 2970)
)

p4 = ggplot(race_missing, aes(x = reorder(category, count), y = count, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = comma(count)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Known" = "#2C7BB6", "Unknown / Missing" = "#D7191C")) +
  labs(title = "RACE Field: Known vs Missing (17.7%)",
       x = NULL, y = "Record Count", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  expand_limits(y = 16000)

print(p4)

# 5. LOS outlier rate by service line
los_outliers = df_selected %>%
  group_by(service_line) %>%
  summarise(
    total       = n(),
    outliers    = sum(los_outlier == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    outlier_pct = round(outliers / total * 100, 1)
  )

p5 = ggplot(los_outliers, aes(x = reorder(service_line, outlier_pct), y = outlier_pct, fill = service_line)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(outlier_pct, "%")), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = service_colors) +
  labs(title = "LOS Outlier Rate by Service Line",
       x = NULL, y = "% of Encounters", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  expand_limits(y = max(los_outliers$outlier_pct) * 1.2)

print(p5)

# 6. Missing ICD descriptors
missing_desc = tibble(
  table   = c("9DX11 (Diagnoses)", "9OP11 (Procedures)"),
  missing = c(15, 6)
)

p6 = ggplot(missing_desc, aes(x = reorder(table, missing), y = missing, fill = table)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = missing), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("9DX11 (Diagnoses)" = "#2C7BB6", "9OP11 (Procedures)" = "#D7191C")) +
  labs(title = "Missing ICD Descriptors in Reference Tables",
       x = NULL, y = "Unmatched Codes", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  expand_limits(y = 20)

print(p6)

# 7. Newborn linkage match rate
newborn_match = tibble(
  category = c("Matched (within 3 days)", "Unmatched"),
  count    = c(1138, 2319 - 1138)
)

p7 = ggplot(newborn_match, aes(x = reorder(category, count), y = count, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = comma(count)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Matched (within 3 days)" = "#1A9641", "Unmatched" = "#D7191C")) +
  labs(title = "Newborn-to-Mother Linkage Match Rate (49.1%)",
       x = NULL, y = "Record Count", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  expand_limits(y = 1500)

print(p7)
```
